format: Makefile (with shell scripting and GNU Make syntax)
description: This file is a makefile for building host-side components in the OpenWrt build system. It includes definition of build directories, configuration variables, compilation and installation rules, and integration points for handling patches and dependencies. It orchestrates the overall process of configuring, compiling, and installing host tools.

methods.name: Host/Prepare/Default
methods.description: Prepares source directory by unpacking and copying source files.

methods.name: Host/Configure/Default
methods.description: Configures the build environment by running configure script with specified environment variables and arguments.

methods.name: Host/Compile/Default
methods.description: Compiles the source code using make with specified jobs and variables.

methods.name: Host/Install/Default
methods.description: Installs compiled components to designated directories.
